mainEntity.name: What is the 3N1 Sports Bar & Grill's address?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3N1 Sports Bar & Grill is located at 2330 Proctor Valley Rd #101, Chula Vista, CA 91914, USA. This is where you will go to get DoorDash Pickup orders, and where Dashers will go to get your DoorDash delivery orders.

mainEntity.name: Does 3N1 Sports Bar & Grill offer delivery or pickup?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can browse 3N1 Sports Bar & Grill’s menu and place an order for both Delivery and Pickup on DoorDash. 3N1 Sports Bar & Grill may also offer delivery and pickup on their own or through other delivery services.

mainEntity.name: Is 3N1 Sports Bar & Grill a DashPass eligible store?

acceptedAnswer.text: 3N1 Sports Bar & Grill offers DashPass benefits like $0 delivery, reduced service fees, and $5 credits back on Pickup orders. If you want to know if a store is DashPass eligible, you can look for the DashPass icon next to their name.
